title: The Murdered Mayor
prompt: A priest is giving his farewell speech. Near the end, the mayor appears to say a few words of thanks, but is shot dead before he finishes speaking.
solution: In his speech, the priest recalled a peculiar murder that happened on his first day in the parish, and said that the first confession he heard that day was the murderer's. The mayor had missed the start of the speech, and said that he had been the first to confess to the new priest. He had given himself away, and a relative of the murdered victim shot him.
